source: Built-in image generation; four separately generated generic illustrations, not photographs of the businesses. Center-cropped and encoded to WebP after visual review.

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Landscape 4:3 editorial stock photograph as an illustration for a driving school listing in Bulgaria, not an actual school branch. Ordinary pale silver compact hatchback from the rear-three-quarter view, parked inside a quiet open asphalt learner practice area with two or three muted orange cones, out-of-focus low greenery and unobtrusive buildings, cool early daylight. Car large and centered for cropping, license plate blank unlettered, no logo, no people, no signage, no text or watermark. Candid natural lighting, no slick advertising look.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Square editorial service illustration for a manual-transmission category B driving lesson. Tight passenger-side view focusing on a driver's left foot in a simple dark everyday sneaker over the far-left clutch pedal, all three realistic pedals visibly aligned in a tasteful simple compact-car footwell, no accelerator pressed. Subtle sun from open side sill, real material textures and sharp subject, modest black and denim tones, no dashboard, no logo, no text, no watermark, no identifiable person; simple readable thumbnail. An entirely generic invented car, not a provider’s vehicle.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Landscape 4:3 editorial stock illustration for a dental prosthetics consultation (not an actual clinic). Objects clear at preview size, subtle realistic microtexture, no printed labels, no logos, no text, no watermark.
